Files of the railway lines

Source: R/rail-line-get.R
rail_line_files.Rd

rail_line_files() lists the file of each year of rail_line_get(): the release of 鉄道 (N02) in ksjdata::ksj_available, its layer of sections of lines, the EPSG code of its coordinate reference system, the number of sections, and its URL. It is used by the bundled pipeline.

Usage

rail_line_files()

Value

A tibble with columns year, file_name, layer, epsg, n_sections, and url.

Examples

rail_line_files()
#> # A tibble: 18 × 6
#>     year file_name      layer                     epsg n_sections url           
#>    <int> <chr>          <chr>                    <int>      <int> <chr>
